Editing the paths to account for your username. Best,
Greg.

> >

> > Oh that doesn't sound ideal. You can get the relevant paths like so (this is from the GitHub issue)
> > # cloudvolume
> > secrets=reticulate::import('cloudvolume.secrets')
> > secrets$secretpath('secrets/cave-secret.json')
> > # Python via reticulate
> > os=reticulate::import('os')
> > os$path$expanduser("~/.cloudvolume/secrets/cave-secret.json")
> >
> > # native R
> > path.expand("~/.cloudvolume/secrets/cave-secret.json")
> > But … I see that you actually have an error message
> >
> > * FlyWire token exists but is not authorised. Set a new token with:
> >   `flywire_set_token()`
> >
> > So from this it actually looks like your token is no longer valid. If you want, you can send it to me privately and I can double check.
> >
> > Two other things you can do.
> >
> > 1. Follow the instruction to do flywire_set_token()
> > 2. Update to this development version of fafbseg in which I try to ensure that Python and R agree on the secrets location and for which the error reporting re tokens should be improved in dr_fafbseg()
> >
> > In a clean R session try
> >
> > remotes::install_github('natverse/fafbseg#154')
> >
> > And then see what dr_fafbseg() says
> >
> > All the best,
> >
> > Greg.

Hi Greg,

My problems with meshparty persist. I completely removed my miniconda env and reinstalled it. When I run simple_python("full", miniconda=TRUE) meshparty version 0.2.2 is installed instead of the newest version. Is there a particular reason for that or is there sth wrong with my installation?

Another issue I am having is that it takes forever to create dotprops from skeletons created using skeletor(method = "wavefront", waves =1, step_size = 10). Do you have any recommendations?

Best
Ibo

> My problems with meshparty persist. I completely removed my miniconda env and reinstalled it. When I run simple_python("full", miniconda=TRUE) meshparty version 0.2.2 is installed instead of the newest version. Is there a particular reason for that or is there sth wrong with my installation?

I think it’s because simple_python prefers binary installs

https://github.com/natverse/fafbseg/blob/d907d3bb6c5fa3104ba7fb66d4ca3b85dd5a15b9/R/utils.R#L378

>
> Another issue I am having is that it takes forever to create dotprops from skeletons created using skeletor(method = "wavefront", waves =1, step_size = 10). Do you have any recommendations?

I haven’t played with those in some time. Do you mean the skeletor step or the dotprops is slow. If the latter are you sure that they are in microns not nm?

>
> Best
> Ibo
